mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.5% in the current period but the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of historical instances.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.8% in the current period but the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of historical instances.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) below their 12-month averages signals broad economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and INDPRO both below 12-month averages but the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of historical instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 210), the central bank's anticipated tightening reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 210 in the current period but the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of historical instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1400 thousand units signal strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1400 but the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of historical instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in total non-farm payrolls below 138000 thousand signals labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 138000 in the current period but the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of historical instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 coupled with a federal funds rate above 5.0% signals monetary tightening and supply contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 115 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0% but the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of historical instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 375000 million dollars signals weakening consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 375000 in a late-cycle expansion regime but the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of historical instances.
